description: This file defines the OA_Permission_User class, which manages user permissions and account data within the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for loading account info, checking admin status, and handling user data.

classes.name: OA_Permission_User
classes.description: A class for managing user permissions and associated account data, including admin checks and account entity retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the user object with data from a DataObjects_Users instance, optionally skipping database access.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Handles reinitialization after unserialization, verifying account associations and permissions.

methods.name: loadAccountData
methods.description: Loads account details for a given account ID, including entity and agency IDs.

methods.name: _clearAccountData
methods.description: Resets the internal account data array to default values.

methods.name: _getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID associated with the current account.

methods.name: _getAgencyId
methods.description: Retrieves the agency ID associated with the current account.

methods.name: _isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user is linked to the admin account.

methods.name: _getEntityDO
methods.description: Factory method to create an entity data object based on account type.
